targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS builds FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS builds FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})

panels.title: Still building
panels.description: A row stays building when the process is still running, or when it never got to write the result.

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS building FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE build_activity.status = 'building' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS building FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE build_activity.status = 'building' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})

targets.queryText: SELECT avg(build_activity.duration_ms) AS duration FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE build_activity.status = 'passed' AND build_activity.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT avg(build_activity.duration_ms) AS duration FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE build_activity.status = 'passed' AND build_activity.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})

panels.title: Avg passed duration by task / config

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id || ' / ' || runs.config_id AS setup, avg(build_activity.duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS seconds FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE build_activity.status = 'passed' AND build_activity.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.config_id ORDER BY seconds DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id || ' / ' || runs.config_id AS setup, avg(build_activity.duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS seconds FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE build_activity.status = 'passed' AND build_activity.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.config_id ORDER BY seconds DESC

panels.title: Builds (newest first)
panels.description: Every Chromium build from the Runs tab or an agent. source is runs-tab or agent. Agent ok is shown as passed, and abandoned as cancelled. duration is the whole build. error is set when it failed or was cancelled.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, build_activity.source, build_activity.target, build_activity.host, build_activity.status, build_activity.started_at, build_activity.duration_ms AS duration, build_activity.error, build_activity.run_id FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) ORDER BY build_activity.started_at DESC LIMIT 200
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, build_activity.source, build_activity.target, build_activity.host, build_activity.status, build_activity.started_at, build_activity.duration_ms AS duration, build_activity.error, build_activity.run_id FROM build_activity JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = build_activity.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) ORDER BY build_activity.started_at DESC LIMIT 200
